about.intro: A digital cycling publication that combines artificial intelligence with real scientific sources. Every article is researched and drafted with the help of AI, then edited and reviewed with journalistic rigor before it is published.
about.whatWeDoP1: PedalSci is built on a premise: cycling deserves science-based journalism grounded in evidence. No opinions disguised as science, no sensationalist headlines. Data, studies and verifiable sources.
about.whatWeDoP2: To get there, we use artificial intelligence as a research and writing tool. Every article starts from real scientific sources — studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar and peer-reviewed journals. AI speeds up the process; editorial judgment decides what gets published and how.
about.whatWeDoP3: Before publication, every article goes through editorial review. Sources are cited explicitly so any reader can verify the information on their own.
about.editorialProcessIntro: PedalSci is produced with an editorial process that is AI-assisted and supervised by people at every stage.
about.step1Text: The editorial team decides what is worth covering and from which angle, prioritizing what genuinely helps the cyclist.
about.step2Text: Every article starts from peer-reviewed literature — studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar and specialized journals — not a generic web summary.
about.step3Title: We draft with the help of AI
about.step3Text: We use artificial intelligence as a tool to draft from those sources. It speeds up the first draft; it does not decide what is true or what gets published.
about.step4Text: Before publishing, the editorial team reviews the text, checks that every claim matches the cited sources and corrects whatever is needed.
about.step5Text: We publish with sources cited explicitly so anyone can verify them. If you spot an error, we fix it.
about.transparencyText: PedalSci is produced with an AI-assisted process supervised by our editorial team. AI helps research and draft from real scientific sources; the decision of what gets published, the fact-checking and the final edit are the responsibility of people. The names for each section are the editorial bylines we publish each specialty under.
